verdict.rationale: Linear documents AI analysis of feedback: you can "analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent", and its marketing says it automatically turns customer feedback into routed, labeled, prioritized issues. Customer requests also attach to the issues and projects customers asked for. Neither claim says AI detects insights inside feedback and links them to existing related feature ideas; the auto-triage claim is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented automatic insight extraction from feedback, AI-driven linking of feedback to existing related issues or projects (feature ideas), in-depth docs on how the Linear Agent feedback analysis works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for, or analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
